title: Lamb Shank Haleem with Barley and Lentils
meta_description: A curated lamb shank haleem: slow-braised shanks, pearl barley, and split lentils with French technique layered over Pakistani soul. Halal, deeply spiced.
og_title: Lamb Shank Haleem — Slow, Spiced, Worth It
og_description: Slow-braised lamb shanks folded into a barley-and-lentil haleem, built with Pakistani spice logic and French patience. One of the most satisfying things you can make on a weekend.

image_briefs.prompt: A wide, shallow ceramic bowl filled with rich dark-brown lamb shank haleem, topped with golden crispy onion tarka, julienned ginger, sliced green chillies, and a scatter of fresh coriander. Soft side light. Linen cloth, dark wood surface. Rustic but composed.
image_briefs.alt: Lamb shank haleem in a ceramic bowl with crispy onion tarka and fresh coriander garnish

image_briefs.prompt: Flat lay of haleem ingredients: whole lamb shanks, pearl barley, chana dal, masoor dal, whole spices including cumin seeds and cardamom, fresh ginger root, garlic, dried red chillies, and a small bowl of garam masala. Clean white surface, natural light.
image_briefs.alt: Ingredients for lamb shank haleem including barley, lentils, whole spices and lamb shanks

image_briefs.prompt: A heavy cast-iron Dutch oven on a stovetop, showing deeply browned lamb shanks being seared in shimmering oil. Dark mahogany crust visible on the meat. Steam rising. Kitchen background slightly blurred.
image_briefs.alt: Searing lamb shanks in a Dutch oven to start the haleem braise

image_briefs.prompt: Close-up of a single serving of lamb shank haleem in a dark-glazed bowl, sheen of ghee visible on the surface, tarka oil pooling at the edges, lemon wedge and naan on the side. Warm indoor light, intimate table setting.
image_briefs.alt: Plated lamb shank haleem with ghee sheen and lemon wedge, ready to serve
